newsitem.title: USA: Saxton hopes Fed rate rise not prelude to others.
newsitem.headline: Saxton hopes Fed rate rise not prelude to others.

text.p: Jim Saxton, Chairman of Congress's Joint Economic Committee, on Tuesday said he hoped the Federal Open Market Committee's quarter-point rate rise would not be followed by others.

"If (Fed) Chairman Alan Greenspan felt that the FOMC had to pre-emptively raise the federal funds rate, hopefully this will be all that is undertaken," said Saxton, a Republican Congressman from New Jersey who has been a frequent defender of the Fed.

"The fact that the Federal Reserve did not raise the discount rate, along with the federal funds rate, suggests that this move may not be a prelude to a string of additional rate hikes," Saxton added in a statement.
